limitations.note: The agent fixed the counter but also made square mode immediately overwrite the previous output on entry, rather than hold it until the counter reaches 9 or 19.
The triangle rewrite changed the initial direction and reversal logic, so the first clock after reset produces 1 rather than the original 5-bit wrap to 31.
The test asserted the rewrite’s triangle startup sequence and immediate square-mode clearing instead of checking that the fix preserved the original behavior.
